description: Calls and contract details the products need that the Ever Platform API contract does not carry yet. Each entry is answered by the mock platform and documented in the outbound-call table as pending upstream; it moves into contracts/openapi/ever-platform.v1.yaml when the platform contract publishes it. Request schemas here are closed and follow the outbound-call table.

lookupCounterparties.why: counterparty_lookup is consented per tenant link, so the platform refuses an installation's lookup without Ever-Link-Id (422 validation_failed at #Ever-Link-Id); the pinned operation also accepts an organization key, which sends no link, and does not declare the header yet

parameters.name: Ever-Link-Id
parameters.description: The tenant link the lookup is made for. Required from an installation: without it the platform answers `422 validation_failed` at `#Ever-Link-Id`.
